description: THE MEANING-LEVEL REVIEW of a collapse reading, as DATA. reading_collapse.read_clause commits to the first shape-match; a shape that decodes CLEANLY but grounds NONSENSE ('I could of done that' -> the possessive learned_of with non-nominal args i_could/done_that) must ESCALATE, not commit. The same collapse recovers BOTH classes of error through ONE mechanism: an incoherent shape has ADJACENT shapes (near-neighbors in some domain's dimension-space) and the resolution is the adjacent shape that COHERES; WHICH domain the corruption came from EMERGES from which adjacency resolves it. TRANSCRIPTION (surface adjacency): 'could of'->PHONOLOGY 'could have' (speech); 'gaot'->KEYBOARD 'goat' (typing); 'tai1'->GLYPH 'tail' (OCR). COGNITIVE (concept adjacency): 'intensive purposes'->CONCEPT 'intents and purposes' (cognitive). The per-domain adjacency is seeded dimension-space structure (a phonology reduction/homophone set, the QWERTY layout, a glyph-confusable set, a concept-confusable set) -- legitimate domain adjacency, NOT a from->to output map: a neighbor WINS only by RE-DECODING to a more coherent reading (the collapse). The DECISIONS are graph Programs: order-N review by incoherence-salience (gap_priority Argmax, reused), escalate-or-stay across adjacency domains (review_escalate, the cascade_pick pattern over ReviewRung), the winning neighbor (candidate_pick Argmax over Candidate by coherence), and stop-by-sufficiency (should_continue, reused). The coherence MEASUREMENT is boundary I/O over the held lexical faculties (dictionary_lexicon / wiktionary) -- the twin of how the perf/understanding perceivers measure salience at the boundary.

microtheory.name: reading_review
microtheory.description: how a collapse reading is REVIEWED for meaning-level coherence: score each grounded predication's incoherence, order most-incoherent-first, escalate the top one across adjacency domains (phonology/keyboard/glyph/concept) until a near-neighbour re-decodes coherently, and stop by sufficiency. The corruption's DOMAIN is the adjacency that resolved it.

attrs.rationale: the review's raw measured salience is a reading's incoherence fraction in 0..1; scale it by 1.5 so ANY real incoherence (>=0.5 for a single ungroundable arg) normalizes above the 0.5 sufficiency floor (should_continue CONTINUES the review), while a coherent reading (0) stays 0 (STOP). A POLICY, tunable; the ORDER is monotone in incoherence either way.

attrs.name: default_review_gate
attrs.description: the coherence floor a candidate re-decode must clear (margin >= threshold) for the review to STAY at the current adjacency domain and ACCEPT that domain as the corruption's source; below it the review ESCALATES to the next domain. A POLICY, tunable -- NOT a universal 'coherent'. margin = 1 - incoherence of the domain's best candidate; a coherent re-decode scores ~1.0, no-candidate scores -1.

attrs.note: the reduced modal-perfect: could've/should've/would've heard as 'could of'.
idiom-level eggcorn: 'for all intensive purposes' <- 'for all intents and purposes'. A multi-word concept-adjacency move.

attrs.name: qwerty
attrs.note: the QWERTY layout as dimension-space: a key's neighbours are its row/column-adjacent keys. Adjacency + transposition generate near-shapes; a neighbour wins only by re-decoding coherently.

a MENTAL-STATE relation (cognition/emotion) selects a SENTIENT subject; a confidently-inanimate subject VIOLATES. This is the richer-than-groundability signal: 'the report infers ...' grounds (infer is a real verb, report a real noun) but the RELATION does not FIT its subject -- a report cannot infer. General linguistic structure (WordNet semantic classes), NOT a word->correction map. The subject's animacy is read from its CURRENT-USAGE sense distribution (WordNet), never from etymology or authority.

a PROPOSITIONAL/clausal object (a that-clause, read as non-nominal by the held is_nominal faculty) is licensed only by a MENTAL or SPEECH relation; a physical relation with a clausal object VIOLATES -- 'the report inters that prices will rise' cannot bury a proposition. This is the discriminator that separates the meaning-correct 'implies' (communication) from the surface-adjacent 'inters' (social/physical), so the meaning repair beats the keyboard repair.

attrs.name: default_license
attrs.description: the LICENSING policy (anti-polygraph): a collapse is licensed only when the best candidate's contextual coherence (1) clears an absolute floor, (2) exceeds the best SAME-TOKEN runner-up by a margin, and (3) exceeds the token-as-itself by a margin. UNDER-FORMED -- a tie within the margin, or a best that as-itself already coheres about as well -- HOLDS OPEN (emits a ReviewResidual carrying the candidates + confidences) rather than force least-perturbation. margin/abs_floor are the risk thresholds; violation_confidence is the precision-weight a selectional violation contributes to incoherence. Correctness is anchored to CURRENT USAGE (the WordNet sense distribution), NOT etymology/authority -- a form that is current-usage-correct is never collapsed to a 'more original' one. A POLICY, tunable.
